$comment: Geography course outline. v1 holds only the 116 sprint track (S1); the zero-to-hero core is added at M1. Edit this JSON, never docs/curriculum/.
subject: geography
decisions: 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied the required subject in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.
Owner (2026-11-28): the 社會 sprint has about 57 chapters (歷史 15, 地理 20, 公民 19, 社會綜合 3), at most 5 codes per 30-minute chapter as in the science sprint.
Owner (2026-11-28): one subject at a time in the order 地理 → 公民 → 歷史, then the shared 社會綜合 part (social.json).

Owner (2026-11-28): no new components for the sprint. Sources and statutes are quoted blocks with provenance and an as-of date, attributed readings use Perspective, maps are schematic Graph drawings labelled 示意圖, time-sensitive values use Fact, and drawing items are rubric self-checks.
Teaching order follows research/verified-2026-11-15.json final_units; every official dependsOn edge between covered codes is respected.
Practice items are original and only modelled on the 111–115 papers; official papers are linked, never copied.
Owner/design (03 §2.1): both either/or regions are reviewed, because CEEC items 不偏版: 東南亞 with 南亞 as the parallel case (Cc), 中南美洲 and 漠南非洲 side by side (Ch).
The three 田野實察 codes are reviewed inside the chapter the 課綱 table puts them after (Bb, Cb, Ci), as inquiry skills read from field data (考試說明: items come from coded 學習內容).
Maps (Ac) before geographic information (Ab), following the research order and the 龍騰/師大附中 sequence.
openQuestions: Map point of view (design 03 §2.5, owner decision): which boundary convention schematic maps of East Asia and the world use, and how the site states it. Until decided, writers draw coastlines and regions only, without national boundaries.
Term mismatch: 課綱 環境負載力 vs 樂詞網 負載力 (s116-population). Proposed: 課綱 term in prose, the 樂詞網 form noted in the glossary entry.
Labels the research marks 'to confirm against the 說明' (the traditions in Aa-Ⅴ-1, the components in Ab-Ⅴ-1, 疊圖分析): writers use them only if the slice or 樂詞網 has them, otherwise they stay generic.
No verified source for elevation data, satellite images or world city statistics: such figures are schematic and labelled 示意圖 / illustrative.
Exam-item links (examItems) and reviewed concepts (reviews) are added per chapter in S2.

title.zh-tw: 地理技能
title.en: Geographic skills

question.zh-tw: 地理學家怎麼提問、找資料，又怎麼用地圖與地理資訊回答？
question.en: How do geographers ask questions, find data, and answer with maps and geographic information?

parts.whyHere: Research final_units 1–3 (Aa, Ac, Ab). Skills come first because every later geography item is read through a map, chart or data set.

title.zh-tw: 地理觀點與研究方法
title.en: Geographic perspectives and research methods

blurb.en: Geography's traditions and viewpoints, framing a research question, collecting and organising data, and the steps of an inquiry.

objectives.zh-tw: 用地理學的傳統與觀點解讀一個生活議題，並說明尺度的影響
objectives.en: Read an everyday issue through geography's traditions and viewpoints, and say how scale changes it

objectives.zh-tw: 把問題化為研究問題，選擇合適的資料來源與蒐集方法
objectives.en: Turn a question into a research question and choose suitable data sources and collection methods

objectives.zh-tw: 整理、分析並以圖表展示資料，依問題探究的步驟提出策略
objectives.en: Organise, analyse and chart data, and follow the inquiry steps to propose a strategy

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Exam link: 111 Q20 (telephone-directory inquiry into an urban issue). Chart reading recaps math data skills in place; link math/s116-data-analysis for statistics. Depth: name the traditions only as the slice or 樂詞網 gives them.

title.zh-tw: 地圖：要素、投影、種類與等高線
title.en: Maps: elements, projections, map types and contours

blurb.zh-tw: 地圖的選擇與簡化、地圖要素、投影變形的合宜應用、普通與主題地圖，以及等高線與暈渲圖判讀。
blurb.en: How maps select and simplify, map elements, choosing a projection for its distortions, general and thematic maps, and reading contours and hillshade.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明地圖的選擇與簡化，並運用比例尺、方向與圖例讀圖
objectives.en: Explain how a map selects and simplifies, and read it with scale, direction and legend

objectives.zh-tw: 判斷投影的變形，選擇合宜的投影

objectives.en: Tell general from thematic maps, and read contours, hillshade and terrain profiles

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Exam links: 114 Q52 (contour reading, 44% correct) and Q53 (legend symbol inside the 3920 m contour); 115 Q36, Q54 (暈渲圖 + 等高線), Q60; 112 Q62 (graduated-symbol map with legend). Depth (附錄三): projections only as distortion and suitable use, not a list of names. Map scale is reviewed in place (math S-6-2 is 國中).

title.en: Geographic information and GIS

objectives.zh-tw: 判斷一個問題要用地理資訊系統的哪種功能，並區分 GIS、遙測與航照

objectives.zh-tw: 判讀衛星影像與數值地形模型，用地理資訊解決生活問題

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps only, links to official CEEC items by year and number, self-check quiz. Exam links: 考試說明 例題3-1 (phone-location clustering is a GIS function, not remote sensing); 115 Q19 (satellite image), Q20 (數值地形模型). Inquiry example: 如何租好屋 (師大附中, research).

title.zh-tw: 地理系統：氣候與地形

parts.whyHere: Research units 4–6 (Ba, Bb, then 田野實察（一）, which the 課綱 table puts after Bb). The 地科 sprint (earth/s116-wind-weather-maps, earth/s116-ocean-currents-el-nino) covers the physics of wind and currents; geography uses them and links there.
